# LineDetector

*Block · lines · `linecaster.blocks.lines`*

Detects the text lines of every page, with their geometry, by a line detection engine.

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Unit | page |
| Role | model |
| Reads | `image` |
| Adds | `ocr_new:lines` |
| Replaces | - |
| Backends | in-process (`InProcess`), served (`Served`), a preset ref (`id@edition`) builds one |
| Catalog step | `lines` |
| Presets | [`pp-ocrv6-medium-det@1`](../../catalog/presets/lines/pp-ocrv6-medium-det.md), [`pp-ocrv6-small-det@1`](../../catalog/presets/lines/pp-ocrv6-small-det.md), [`pp-ocrv6-tiny-det@1`](../../catalog/presets/lines/pp-ocrv6-tiny-det.md) |
| Comes after | [`ImageFolderReader`](../readers/ImageFolderReader.md), [`ImageParquetReader`](../readers/ImageParquetReader.md), [`ManifestReader`](../readers/ManifestReader.md), [`PageRecordReader`](../readers/PageRecordReader.md), [`PdfReader`](../readers/PdfReader.md) |
| Comes before | [`LineAssigner`](LineAssigner.md), [`LineRecognizer`](../recognition/LineRecognizer.md), [`Composer`](../composition/Composer.md), [`Recomposer`](../composition/Recomposer.md), [`Typographer`](../composition/Typographer.md), [`ItemTextWriter`](../writers/ItemTextWriter.md), [`PageFileWriter`](../writers/PageFileWriter.md) |
| Used in | [`transcribe_modular.v1`](../../catalog/pipelines/transcribe_modular.v1.md) |
| Source | [detector.py](https://github.com/storytracer/linecaster/blob/main/src/linecaster/blocks/lines/detector.py) |

The contract is that of `LineDetector(backend='pp-ocrv6-medium-det@1')`; the comes-after and comes-before rows are derived from every block's contract.

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `backend` | `InProcess \| Served \| str` | required | where the engine runs: `InProcess`, `Served`, or a catalog preset's ref (`id` or `id@edition`) for its engine in the pipeline's process; a preset of another step is refused (`PipelineConfigError`). |
| `transcription` | `str` | `'ocr_new'` | the transcription the step reads and adds to. |
| `params` | `dict \| None` | `None` | keyword arguments for every call of the engine (in-process) or sent with every request (served); `None`: none. |
| `primary` | `str \| None` | `None` | the transcription whose text becomes the datatrove document's `text`; `None`: `transcription`. |
| `skip_on_error` | `bool` | `True` | pass pages that carry errors through unprocessed. |
| `name` | `str \| None` | `None` | the block's name in stats and logs; `None`: `"<step> (<backend>)"`. |

## Behavior

Reads the page image; adds `lines` (polygons, boxes, baselines where the engine gives them: what its preset
produces). Lines found on the whole page are assigned to the layout regions afterwards by a `LineAssigner`.

## Contract

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    B["LineDetector"]
    r0["image"] --> B
    B --> a0["ocr_new:lines"]
```

```python
LineDetector("pp-ocrv6-medium-det@1")
```
